confirmed_cause: Packaged application excludes lxml and uses et_xmlfile, which emits styled empty cells as self-closing <c ... />. The original cache regex consumed the following formula cell, causing Formula cell missing from generated row.
reproduction: OPENPYXL_LXML=False; styled blank A1 then formula B1 reproduces the same failure.
fix: Exclude self-closing c nodes from nonempty formula-cell regex. Original formula/amount semantics unchanged.
